report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with mostly low latency; one 344ms outlier aligns with a 322ms order call. No errors, no 5xx, no pool exhaustion, no memory growth, no deployment facts. Current evidence does not establish any bounded root cause; the alert is not corroborated as a fault.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency or error metrics for /v1/checkout beyond the single 60s window
Baseline latency distribution to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
Downstream order/payment/inventory latency breakdown for the slow request
Any error logs or 5xx counts during the incident window
